Method of Attack: SOCKS5 buffer overflow vulnerability (CVE-2023-38546). An attacker can trigger the vulnerability and execute code by constructing a malicious hostname.
Discoverer: Curl official and Qi Anxin Technology Research Institute
Impacted Systems: Open-source components in PyPI, NPM, crates.io
Attack Vector: When using a SOCKS5 proxy, curl is asked to pass the hostname to the SOCKS5 proxy for resolution instead of doing it itself. If the hostname length exceeds 255 bytes, curl switches to local resolution and only passes the resolved address to the proxy. Due to not working as expected, curl copies the overly long hostname to the target buffer, causing a heap buffer overflow.

Method of Attack: pycurl wraps the user's local libcurl library, providing the corresponding Python call interface to achieve faster network access requests. If the user's local libcurl is a version with a vulnerability, then the software using pycurl will also be under attack threat.
node-libcurl library binding software package for Node.js may lead to security risks.
curl-sys uses the local libcurl library, which may be affected by the vulnerable versions of libcurl components.
